title: Color Slider
description: Adjust the slider to match the moving color bar! Test your reflexes and color matching skills.
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. A color bar will move horizontally across the screen.
3. Adjust the slider to match the color of the moving bar.
4. Press the action key (SPACE / joystick button) to confirm the match.
5. Earn points for accurate matches.
6. Try to get the highest score before time runs out!

Tips:
- Watch the color carefully.
- Timing is key.
- Accuracy gives higher points!
